problem: The CLI currently exposes only library list, show, and comments (list/post) commands. No create, iterate, publish, or delete commands exist. The design must define new CLI surfaces for standalone report authoring and lifecycle management.

files.why: Library command router/dispatcher. Dispatches to list, show, comments subcommands. Entry point for new create/iterate/publish/delete commands.
List command: fetches GET /api/library/items, displays table with ID/Title/Status/CreatedAt. Types: LibraryItem has id/title/status/createdAt.
Show command: fetches item detail + comment summary, parses HTML/markdown headings, annotates sections with comment counts. Types: LibraryItemDetail has content/filePath.
Comments subcommand router: dispatches to list and post.
Comments list: fetches GET /api/library/items/:id/comments, groups by anchor section.
Reference resolution utility: resolves item by exact ID, ticket short ID (case-insensitive), or title substring. Used by show and comments commands.
HTTP client: native fetch with retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff), 30s timeout, API key auth. Pattern for new API calls.
Main CLI entry point: registers 'library' command at line 108-111.
Build: 'tsc'. Typecheck: 'tsc --noEmit'. Test: 'tsc && node --test dist/**/*.test.js'. No lint command.

facts: CLI stack: TypeScript compiled to ES2022, Node16 module resolution. Native Node test runner.
Current library commands: list, show <ref>, comments list <ref>, comments post <ref>. No create, iterate, publish, or delete.
Reference resolution: three-tier (exact ID, ticket short ID, title substring). Fetches full items list to resolve.
HTTP client: hxFetch with retry logic, API key auth (X-API-Key header), org context (X-Helix-Org-ID header).
Flag parsing: simple getFlag/hasFlag/requireFlag utilities. New commands would follow this pattern.
The show command already reads filePath from item detail — pattern exists for file-aware display.
No existing publish or delete commands despite API endpoints existing for both.
unknowns: Whether new CLI commands should accept file paths for local content or use stdin/pipe patterns.
Whether the CLI should support markdown authoring with automatic HTML conversion.
Whether the CLI needs a 'library publish' and 'library delete' command (API endpoints exist but CLI doesn't expose them).
How the CLI should handle the --file flag for create/iterate: read local file or reference a git path.
